articles.title: Yale Expert Warns Nvidia Is a Detriment to US Industry
articles.summary: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO could backfire. He highlights potential personal liability for directors from lawsuits and questions celebrating a company that supplied advanced chips to foreign adversaries.

articles.title: Trump Reportedly Says Pardoning Jensen Huang Is an Option
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces ongoing scrutiny regarding his association with Alice Huang, an executive accused of ties to Chinese intelligence and past involvement in illegally diverting Nvidia microchips to China.

articles.title: Jensen Huang Argues Succession Plans Create Unnecessary Hierarchy
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang maintains that establishing a formal succession plan creates unnecessary corporate hierarchy, a surprising viewpoint following the recent weeks the company spent operating without its prominent founder at the helm.

articles.title: Jensen Huang Thanks White House and Mentions Therapy in Meeting
articles.summary: During an all-hands meeting, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang apologized to his employees, expressed gratitude for a second chance to lead the firm, thanked the White House, and mentioned that he is currently attending therapy.

articles.title: Advanced AI Agents Still Struggle with Everyday Life Tasks
articles.summary: As personal AI assistants gain popularity, a new benchmark reveals that even the most sophisticated models fail to execute everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing unforeseen problems for users.

articles.title: Walmart Partners with Meta to Integrate Deals into Muse
articles.summary: Walmart has announced a new partnership allowing customers to browse and shop Black Friday deals directly through Muse, the artificial intelligence agent developed by Meta.

articles.title: Maple Secures Funding to Build Privacy-Focused AI Products
articles.summary: Startup Maple has raised $5.3 million to develop an encrypted artificial intelligence architecture designed to protect user data by preventing even the company itself from accessing private information.

articles.title: Dozens of Oil and Shipping Tankers Targeted in Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Recent reports indicate that dozens of oil and chemical shipping vessels have been compromised in cyberattacks over the past few weeks, with Iran emerging as the primary suspect behind the security breaches.

articles.title: Anthropic Shares Drop Below IPO Price in Worrying Sign
articles.summary: Anthropic shares have fallen below their initial public offering price, marking a concerning trend that could place downward pressure on the valuations of other artificial intelligence startups.

articles.title: UK Warns AI Cyberattacks Expose Years of Weak Security
articles.summary: The British cyber agency warns that building strong security foundations is critical because modern AI-powered hacking tools easily exploit simple vulnerabilities left unaddressed for years.

articles.title: Threads Launches on iPad and Introduces Cashtags Feature
articles.summary: Threads is now available on the iPad and has added live stock quotes and charts, adopting a feature from X to attract the financial community.

articles.title: Electric Truck Startup Harbinger Secures New Financing
articles.summary: Electric truck manufacturer Harbinger has obtained new capital through Palmer Luckey's Erebor Bank as part of the startup's strategy to diversify its funding sources for future growth.

articles.title: US Financial Crimes Bureau Discloses Cybersecurity Incident
articles.summary: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, part of the Treasury Department, announced it is investigating a cybersecurity incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems.

articles.title: US Army Plans Controlled Detonation of Lead Azide in Iowa
articles.summary: The US Army is proceeding with plans to detonate nearly 10,000 pounds of unstable lead azide explosives from the national stockpile at an ammunition manufacturing plant located in Middletown, Iowa.

articles.title: Huawei Found Guilty of Stealing US Trade Secrets
articles.summary: A federal jury in New York has found Huawei guilty of stealing proprietary technology and source code from American companies including T-Mobile and Cisco, concluding a lengthy legal battle.

articles.title: Take-Two Shuts Down Fan-Made GTA VI PC Recompilation
articles.summary: Publisher Take-Two issued a DMCA takedown notice to shut down Leonida, a fan project created by a 15-year-old developer attempting to run a leaked Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI on PC.

articles.title: TikTok Experiences Global Outage Affecting Core Features
articles.summary: TikTok suffered a temporary outage that impacted core app functionalities, preventing users from properly loading videos, search results, and favorites on their feeds following previous technical disruptions.

articles.title: Jensen Huang Denies Trump Was Responsible for His Return
articles.summary: During his first all-hands meeting since returning, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to staff and explicitly denied reports that the White House or tech leaders orchestrated his reinstatement.

articles.title: Congress Scrambles to Reauthorize Contentious Wiretapping Law
articles.summary: Lawmakers are racing to renew the controversial Section 702 warrantless wiretapping authority under the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act before the legislative session ends, potentially attaching it to a military spending bill.

articles.title: Amazon Offers Discount on Six Months of Apple TV
articles.summary: Amazon is offering a significant discount for US customers on a six-month subscription to Apple TV, reducing the streaming service's standard monthly cost significantly for eligible account holders.

articles.title: Half of NASA Mars Fleet Impaired by Technical Issues
articles.summary: NASA's aging Mars exploration fleet is facing severe technical hurdles, with the Perseverance rover experiencing data transmission difficulties while the Odyssey orbiter rapidly depletes its remaining fuel reserves.

articles.title: Microsoft Cloud Outage Triggered Code Red and Overhaul
articles.summary: Internal documents reveal that Microsoft's major cloud outage prompted a Code Red engineering overhaul alongside the establishment of ambitious one-hour recovery goals to prevent future incidents.

articles.title: New AI-Assisted Proof Spark Debate on Riemann Hypothesis
articles.summary: A recently developed artificial intelligence-assisted mathematical proof appears mathematically sound, though researchers are still working to fully understand its broader implications and meaning.

articles.title: US Measles Deaths Rise as National Tally Reaches 14
articles.summary: The United States total count of measles fatalities has climbed to 14 after Wisconsin and Pennsylvania recently reported multiple consecutive deaths attributed to the ongoing outbreak.

articles.title: Amazon Drone Crashes on Garage Following Delivery
articles.summary: An Amazon Prime Air delivery drone crashed onto a residential garage after dropping off an order of shampoo, prompting an active investigation by the Federal Aviation Administration.

articles.title: Amazon Relies on SpaceX and Ariane 6 for Satellite Launches
articles.summary: With hundreds of satellites currently sitting in storage awaiting deployment, Amazon has increasingly turned to Falcon 9 and Ariane 6 rockets to deliver its payloads into space.

articles.title: Study Finds Brewers Can Use Smoke-Tainted Hops Safely
articles.summary: Recent research indicates that brewers can incorporate up to 50 percent of smoke-tainted hops into their recipes without negatively impacting the overall taste and aroma of the finished beer.

articles.title: Kalshi Halts Utah Trading Operations After Court Defeats
articles.summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi announced it made the difficult decision to suspend its trading operations in Utah following a series of unsuccessful legal battles in the state.

articles.title: Tidal Bans AI-Generated Music and Plans Massive Track Deletion
articles.summary: Tidal has announced a complete ban on artificial intelligence-generated music, a policy that will result in the removal of roughly 27 million tracks, accounting for over six percent of its catalog.

articles.title: Porsche 718 Boxster Electric Prototype Impresses on Drive
articles.summary: Early test drives of the electric Porsche 718 Boxster prototype reveal that the upcoming battery-powered roadster is exceptionally fun to drive, even though complete technical specifications remain scarce.

articles.title: New New York Law Bans Heated Seat Subscriptions in Cars
articles.summary: A new law in New York will outlaw ongoing subscription fees for automotive features like heated seats starting in 2027, though services with continuous operating costs present a notable loophole.

articles.title: White House Seeks $2 Billion NASA Funding Boost
articles.summary: The White House is requesting an additional $2 billion in funding for NASA to accelerate the Artemis lunar program and prevent anticipated delays in upcoming space exploration activities.

articles.title: Guide to Changing Roku TV Settings for Cinematic Movies
articles.summary: Users can adjust their Roku TV display settings, which are often configured to a 60 frames-per-second refresh rate by default, to watch movies closer to how filmmakers originally intended.

articles.title: Apple Watch and CarPlay Integrate to Assist Drivers
articles.summary: Apple's ecosystem links the Apple Watch and CarPlay together to help drivers maintain focus, stay on course, and remain alert during long road trips.
